leads.reason: Genuinely large specimen (545cm girth, 32m), register-confirmed, at Villa delle Rose, a municipal modern-art venue (Galleria d'Arte Moderna) with public gardens but gallery-style opening hours rather than a park's. Not shipped this pass: it stands roughly 1.7-2.2km from the nearest published Bologna tree (bol_009 Villa Ghigi, bol_005 Rizzoli), too far to join either as a walk, so it would open a lone third location rather than deepen an existing one. Worth a second look together with any other Villa Saragozza-area candidates if the cluster ever grows enough to justify a third Bologna walk; confirm the venue's actual public access and hours before shipping.
leads.checked_2026_08_17: Villa delle Rose is now an external MAMbo venue "destinata a esposizioni temporanee ed eventi" (Italian Wikipedia): it hosts temporary exhibitions rather than standing open as a park, and no source found gives regular public hours independent of an active show. Access is genuinely intermittent, not just gallery-style, so this still fails the honest-access-line test until a pass finds either standing garden hours or confirmation the grounds are open between exhibitions. Left as a lead, not shipped. Also: the register's other Bologna near-city entries (0.4 to 1.9 km from centre) are all flagged as probably-already-published in passcheck's brief, so this cedar remains the only real close-in unmined candidate; the rest of the register's unmined rows sit 6+ km out and stand alone.
